```yaml
  verified: true
  CVE: CVE-2013-7436
  CWE: CWE-310

message: Potential security vulnerability in WebUtil.createCookie function
severity: ERROR
pattern:
  metavar: $X
  metavars:
    - $X: $JS(var date, expires, secure; if (days) { date = new Date(); date.setTime(date.getTime()+(days*24*60*60*1000)); expires = "; expires="+date.toGMTString(); } else { expires = ""; }; if (document.location.protocol === "https:") { secure = "; secure"; } else { secure = ""; }; document.cookie = name+"="+value+expires+"; path=/"+secure;)
  languages:
    - javascript
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the usage of the vulnerable `WebUtil.createCookie` function. It will match any usage of the function where the `secure` variable is not set to a value that depends on the protocol of the current location.
